name: 芯源微
thesis: Semicap equipment is participating in today's electronics-led rally, and the stock fits the sweet-spot RPS with clean MA distances. Not extended, so this is a valid momentum re-entry candidate if looking to rotate from cold chemical exposure into hot tech beta.
